authorizationSource.question: May I adopt the corrected supply contract 382 for A’s PG366-W03-R1 branch in unchanged fixture 367 only? It defines the existing 8 lb REST-WATER-367-A item as one potable-water unit, treats one unit plus one 2 lb day ration as sufficient for this one-hour test, and requires no consumption. It does not change canonical rules, fixture bytes, rest benefits, settlement, W03 seal, Fortress disposition, or the 828/20/0 queue. authorizationSource.answer: Yes, adopt 382 for this branch only
